thread:
jules: Opening a docs PR: SUSE-focused on-prem quickstart for Private deployments. Includes SoftHSM PKCS#11 example, nftables ruleset, systemd persistence snippet, and a tiny installer troubleshooting note. Requesting quick review on network and HSM bits before merge.

samira: Love the SUSE angle. Could you add a short migration note for teams moving from iptables -> nftables? One sentence + link to compat guidance is fine.

naveen: Looked at nft rules: please avoid hardcoding eth0. On SUSE it's often ens*; recommend showing a generic iif "<mgmt-iface>" placeholder and a concrete SUSE example using ens192. Also mention wicked vs systemd-networkd differences.

jules: Will change to interface placeholders and add a SUSE example. Also planning to include this compact nftables snippet for SUSE minimal host:```nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
# loopback
nft add rule inet redwood input iif lo accept
# established contexts
nft add rule inet redwood input ct state established,related accept
# mgmt SSH from mgmt net
nft add rule inet redwood input iif "ens*" ip saddr 10.0.0.0/24 tcp dport 22 accept
# app ports
nft add rule inet redwood input tcp dport {80,443,8080} counter accept
# default drop
nft add rule inet redwood input counter drop```

luca: For PKCS#11, add SoftHSM slot mapping and a quick pkcs11-tool troubleshooting note: if pkcs11-tool errors CKR_SLOT_ID_INVALID, ensure token label matches /etc/softhsm/softhsm2.conf and ownership perms on /var/lib/softhsm/tokens.

naveen: Add this SoftHSM config sample and the init command to the PR:```ini
# /etc/softhsm/softhsm2.conf
directories.tokendir = /var/lib/softhsm/tokens
objectstore.backend = file
log.level = INFO
```
Init token:```bash
softhsm2-util --init-token --free --label "redwood-hsm" --pin 1234 --so-pin 5678
```

jules: Good. Also adding a small systemd persistence step: `nft list ruleset > /etc/nftables.conf` and enable via `systemctl enable --now nftables.service` (and a note for SUSE that some images require creating /etc/systemd/system/nftables.service if absent).

samira: docs link-checker popped a stale HSM link (docs/internal/old-hsm-setup). Replace with docs/security/hsm-provisioning and add a cross-ref to our PKCS#11 appendix.

luca: Call out kernel modules required on minimal SUSE images: vhost_net, nf_conntrack, and nft_fib_netdev. If nf_conntrack is missing the installer healthcheck shows "conntrack disabled" in logs. Add the one-liner to modprobe and a systemd drop-in if needed.

jules: I'll add: `modprobe nf_conntrack vhost_net nft_fib_netdev` and note persistent via /etc/modules-load.d/redwood.conf.

naveen: For air-gapped bundles include a short 2-line checklist near the top: 1) Include SoftHSM RPM and dependencies in bundle; 2) Include nftables package and systemd unit. Keeps it visible.

jules: Perfect. I'll update the PR with these changes and push in ~20 mins, then ping reviewers. Thanks! :rocket: 

docbot: Link check: new PR changes pass and external link to SUSE networking docs is reachable. One lint nit: code fence language on nft snippet should be "bash" or removed; small fix made automatically.
